snacs_adaptation_notes.txt:
SNACS v2.6 adaptation notes from authorized guidelines and purchased reviews examples. Output each target as [scene role, lexical function], with p. prefixes. Scene role reflects the relation in context; function reflects what the marker conventionally expresses. Check each target's actual governor and object.

Genitives and possessives: possessive pronouns commonly have p.Gestalt function, while their scene role depends on the relation to the head noun. 'my fusions' (patient undergoing surgery) = p.Theme/p.Gestalt; 'my back' or 'my hair' (body part) = p.Whole/p.Gestalt; 'my experience' and 'my needs' = p.Experiencer/p.Gestalt; 'their product' and 'my complaint' (created or expressed by possessor) = p.Originator/p.Gestalt. 'our arrival,' 'your choice,' and 'my wedding day' = p.Agent/p.Gestalt. 'my life' = p.Theme/p.Gestalt. Established interpersonal or professional ties take p.SocialRel/p.Gestalt: 'your child,' 'my waiter,' 'his staff,' 'our waitress,' 'my therapist.' Group membership takes p.OrgMember/p.Gestalt: 'my family and friends,' 'my high school cafeteria.' A loose association such as 'their hours,' 'our Key Performance Indicators,' or 'my own style' can be p.Gestalt/p.Gestalt. Alienable property takes p.Possessor/p.Possessor: 'our fence,' 'their money,' 'your money/time/bottle,' 'my G1 screen/pizza/$25.' Do not infer p.Possessor solely from possessive form.

Quantity, part, and substance: 'a limited amount of time' = p.QuantityItem/p.Gestalt for of with a measure noun plus modifier. 'a whole day of work' and 'a cup of coffee' = p.QuantityItem/p.QuantityItem. 'a batch of wings' = p.QuantityItem/p.Stuff; 'a glob of chewy fat' = p.Stuff/p.Stuff. 'worst of all' = p.Whole/p.Whole (comparison set); 'side of Murfreesboro' = p.Whole/p.Whole. 'Taj Mahal of the east coast' = p.Locus/p.Whole. 'lunch special with your choice of meat' = p.PartPortion/p.PartPortion; 'choice of meat' = p.Topic/p.Topic; 'depth of region, varietal, and vintage' = p.Species/p.Species.

Identity and comparison: 'a gem of a restaurant' = p.Identity/p.Identity; 'as my therapist' = p.Identity/p.Identity. 'identical to,' 'resemblance to,' and 'compares to' take p.ComparisonRef/p.Goal. Comparative than = p.ComparisonRef/p.ComparisonRef. 'the same in all languages and foods' = p.Characteristic/p.Locus.

Spatial: ordinary destination 'to the ER/website/school' = p.Goal/p.Goal; recipient of transfer, referral, speech, or report 'to a collection agency/therapist/reception person/bureau' = p.Recipient/p.Goal. 'from Nashville/Oklahoma' = p.Source/p.Source; 'down I-24' and 'cars speeding by' = p.Path/p.Path; 'wander around' = p.Locus/p.Path. 'come in' and 'go back' can be p.Direction/p.Direction. 'in the office/hospital/cafeteria/agreement,' '@ Yards Brewery,' 'up front,' and 'out there' = p.Locus/p.Locus.

Temporal: 'after my fusions,' 'during mornings,' 'in August,' 'upon our arrival,' 'after 9pm,' 'on weekends,' and 'in my life' = p.Time/p.Time. 'two weeks ago' = p.Time/p.Interval, with 'about' = p.Approximator/p.Approximator. 'for a year/years/so long' = p.Duration/p.Duration. 'on a weekly basis' is one multiword target = p.Frequency/p.Manner.

Purpose, reason, topic: 'recommend for custom lighting,' 'go for coupons,' 'visit for quitting smoking,' 'for my printing needs,' 'to go over indicators,' and 'to satisfy a sommelier' = p.Purpose/p.Purpose. 'for lunch' as meal occasion = p.Circumstance/p.Circumstance. 'with child predators out there' framing a situation = p.Circumstance/p.Circumstance. 'for such horrible customer relations' (reason) and causal 'since' = p.Explanation/p.Explanation. 'ask for help/a different pair' = p.Theme/p.Theme. 'a problem with their hours,' 'suck at my style,' 'pictures of me,' and 'as to the price' = p.Topic/p.Topic.

Other patterns: passive human actor 'owned/operated by people' = p.Agent/p.Agent; passive nonagentive influence 'influenced by' and 'victim of hard times' = p.Force/p.Force. Reciprocal 'chatting/laughing with each other' = p.Agent/p.Ancillary. 'work with Shannon' and 'easy to work with' = p.SocialRel/p.Ancillary; accompanying children = p.Ancillary/p.Ancillary. 'with higher prices/no resemblance/my hair curly' = p.Characteristic/p.Characteristic. 'into wine' = p.Characteristic/p.Goal. 'in a timely manner' = p.Manner/p.Manner. 'for $10/free' = p.Cost/p.Cost. 'five dollars off' = p.Theme/p.Source. These are observed examples, not gold labels for unseen instances.
